tools.name: pz_state
tools.description: The survivor right now, as the game itself wrote it out: in-game day and clock, whether it is night, indoors or outside and which room, health, infection, hunger, thirst, fatigue, stamina, and the mood stats (pain, panic, stress, unhappiness, boredom), how many zombies are visible, what is in your hands and its condition, and roughly what the bag holds. Also says whether the data is still arriving. Use this whenever you need to know what is happening right now.

summary.zh: 读此刻的完整处境：第几天、几点、血、感染、饿渴累、心情、视野里多少僵尸、手上拿的什么、背包有什么。
summary.en: The current situation in full: day, clock, health, infection, needs, mood, visible zombies, weapon and bag.

tools.name: pz_recent
tools.description: The last few things that actually happened, oldest first: damage taken, getting infected, kills, nightfall, death. Each carries the in-game day it happened on. Use it to remember the run of play instead of guessing.

limit.description: How many to return, 1-20. Defaults to 8.

summary.zh: 最近发生的事：掉血、感染、击杀、入夜、死亡，按时间顺序。
summary.en: The last things that happened: damage, infection, kills, nightfall, death.

tools.name: pz_tips
tools.description: A checklist computed from the current state, not from opinion: missing bandages, no water, no light source after dusk, weapon about to break, stamina gone, infection. Empty when nothing is wrong. Use it when the person asks what they should do next or why they keep dying.

summary.zh: 按当前状态算出来的检查清单：缺绷带、没水、没光源、武器快断、体力见底、感染。没问题时是空的。
summary.en: A checklist computed from the state: bandages, water, light, weapon condition, stamina, infection.

tools.name: pz_journal
tools.description: Your own survivor notebook — first person, across runs. Read it with no arguments. `add` writes one short line into a section (alive = how this run is being lived, death = which step killed me, next = what to watch for, unsure = not figured out yet). `drop` removes the first line containing that text. This is NOT a tips sheet: bandages and stamina belong in pz_tips. Write only after a run ends or after a mistake worth remembering — not every close call.

add.description: One line, first person, at most 120 characters. A conclusion you actually reached, not a sentence copied from a guide.

drop.description: Remove the first line containing this text.

summary.zh: 读或写自己的跨周目陪玩复盘笔记。
summary.en: Read and write your own survivor notebook across runs.

tools.name: pz_play
tools.description: Execute one survivor action when "allowPlay" is enabled and `hands.on` is false. Verbs: walk/face/attack/take/door/eat/drink/cook/craft/look/equip/menu/pick/squad/order/recruit/guide/dog/dogo/dogwait/dogfree/stop/guard. Use `menu` to inspect right-click interactions at your tile and `pick` by index; `look` reads containers without opening UI; `attack` is for active engagement (close-range auto-reflex already handles threats within 2 tiles unless guard=false). Issuing returns command acceptance only — check `busy` and coordinates in `pz_state` before queuing the next move. If the user verbally asks you to stop or hand control back, pass verb="stop" with hold=true and do not act again until explicit verbal permission with resume=true.

x.description: World X (walk / face / take / look / guide / dogo / optional door).

y.description: World Y (walk / face / take / look / guide / dogo / optional door).

objIdx.description: Container object index on square from pz_state/look (take only).

recipe.description: Exact recipe name copied verbatim from pz_recipes (craft only).

index.description: Menu option index from pz_state menu.list[].i (pick only).

id.description: Squad NPC id from pz_state squad.list[].id (order / recruit / guide).

job.description: order job: follow, hold, guard, patrol, explore, farm, relax, sort, corpses, auto, fish, clean, cook, chop, dismantle, medic.

on.description: guard reflex switch: true (default) auto-swings within 2 tiles; false pauses auto-swing.

hold.description: Set true with verb="stop" to pause autonomous actions until explicit verbal resume=true.

resume.description: Set true only after user explicitly grants control back to clear verbal hold.

summary.zh: 在游戏内执行一项操作（默认只陪聊，需手动开启 worlds.pz.allowPlay 授权）。
summary.en: Execute one survivor action in game when play permission is enabled.

tools.name: pz_recipes
tools.description: Query genuinely craftable recipes right now (checks inventory, skills, workbench and heat source). Always check before `pz_play` verb `craft` and copy names verbatim. An empty list means nothing can be crafted where you stand. This read-only query asks the bridge to scan; it never crafts, but is refused while verbal hold is active.

summary.zh: 查询当前可制作配方及准确名称，供 pz_play craft 使用。
summary.en: List recipes you can actually craft right now.

description.zh: 天在暗了（19 点后、还没入夜）。
description.en: Dusk: past 19:00 and not yet night.

description.zh: 视野里的僵尸跨了一档。
description.en: The visible-zombie count jumped a band.

description.zh: 他自己的状态跨了一档（饿、渴、累、体力、疼、惊恐、压力、心情、无聊）。
description.en: One of his own condition stats crossed a band.

description.zh: 手上的武器耐久见底了。
description.en: The weapon in hand is nearly worn out.

description.zh: 轮到决定下一步动作（需手动开启 worlds.pz.allowPlay 授权）。
description.en: It is your turn to decide the next move when play permission is enabled.

description.zh: 他正打开的那个容器里有值得停一下的东西（只看已经打开的那一个）。
description.en: The container he has open holds something worth pausing for. Only the one he opened.

description.zh: 前期电视上有技能课（Life and Living TV），一天最多提一次，第 5 天之后不提。
description.en: A skill programme is on or about to start on Life and Living TV. Once a day, first five days only.

description.zh: 一小会儿里连杀了好几只。
description.en: Several kills in a short stretch.

description.zh: 清单里那条还悬着（没水、没绷带、武器快断这类），隔一阵提醒一次，换着说法。
description.en: A checklist item is still open; a periodic nudge, reworded each time.

description.zh: 这台机器的环境不对：找不到存档目录、mod 没装进去、或者一直没有数据。
description.en: Environment problem: no save dir, mod not installed, or no data at all.

description.zh: 用户交接（handoff）结束时顺路搭车（piggyback）补齐当前局内或连接状态的最新快照。
description.en: Piggybacked game or connection snapshot after user handoff ends.
